8.name: Episode 1
8.overview: Love island and The Monk are back, baby. This year we're going tropical in a brand new Villa. It's a season of big power moves, who will be willing to risk it all for love?

8.name: Episode 2
8.overview: Five single girls met five single boys, and now they all meet a smoking hot Bombshell. All eyes are on the new girl, but which boy does she have her sights set on?

8.name: Episode 3
8.overview: Fallout from Secret Squirrel has some Islanders going nuts. It's the first Firepit of the season, where the Bombshell must steal a boy, leaving one girl single and ready to graft.

8.name: Episode 4
8.overview: Two brand new Bombs enter the Villa ready to crack on! Then, for the first time, the power couples will take control. Somebody is about to be dumped, the only question is - who?

8.name: Episode 5
8.overview: It's a brand new week in the Love Island Villa, full of romantic dates with the new bombs, smitten girls, and jealous boys. And it wouldn't be Love Island without a few fights.

8.name: Episode 6
8.overview: It's all fun and games until it's not. The Villa gets a text, it's time to play a game called Get Lucky. Who hits the jackpot, and which Islanders crash out?

8.name: Episode 7
8.overview: Secret kisses are not so secret, as some Islanders learn. They freaked around and got found out! A smoking new Bombshell makes her way into the Villa, turning all the boys heads.

8.name: Episode 8
8.overview: Everyone is abuzz about the Barbie-esque Bombshell, this is her dreamhouse now and the girls are not happy about it. This might be the USA Villa but it's packed with Aussie drama!

8.name: Episode 9
8.overview: After crash outs, confrontations, a photobooth scandal and a new face, it's time for a recoupling and a dumping. Our Bombshell has the Villa in a spin, but who will she steal?

8.name: Episode 10
8.overview: Fasten your seatbelts! The power couples are in the cockpit, and there's turbulence ahead. A game of Power Trip causes chaos in the Villa, and a brand new bomb is dropped.

8.name: Episode 11
8.overview: A hot new Bomb has entered the Villa and he's given a very warm welcome from the girls with a Kissing Challenge. There's new chemistry, concerns, controversy and competition!

8.name: Episode 12
8.overview: The love triangles are getting pointy, and one couple enjoys a blissful date with a twist. Later, at the firepit there's a shocking steal, a dumping, and a Power Play is enacted!

8.name: Episode 13
8.overview: While the girls of the Villa are away for the day, two sexy new Bombshells come out to play. But on Love Island, someone is always watching, and the truth always comes out.

8.name: Episode 14
8.overview: The fallout of the arrival of the new bombs is shaking up the Villa and things are headed for a meltdown. Some actions lead to breakups, makeups, and a love triangle blow up.

8.name: Episode 15
8.overview: It's time for a recoupling, and the bombs are busy making connections, but who will they chose? Buckle up for a firepit of shocks, surprises, and the arrival of a sexy Scotsman!

8.name: Episode 16
8.overview: The new bomb has the girls all revved up in a game of Pole Position. And just when we thought the love triangle was over, one girl sends things right back into a tailspin.

8.name: Episode 17
8.overview: The relationship vibes in the Villa are going strong, until a Love Island world first - the ultimate Power Couple Power Move. Their votes are in, and one couple is going home.

overview: The Australian version of the hit UK's reality show, Love Island. In Mallorca, Spain, 10 Aussie singles will play the ultimate game of love. After finding their match, they must stay together while surviving temptations as new singles enter the villa.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Hosted by Sophie Monk from the Spanish island of Mallorca, 10 beautiful Aussie singles will play the ultimate game of love. After they find their match, they must stay together while surviving temptations as new singles enter the villa.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: 'Love Island Australia' is back and off to Fiji, where a new set of singles hope to find love (and $50,000), with a whole bunch of twists, too. Hosted by Sophie Monk.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: It's off to beautiful Byron Bay for a bunch of sexy singles looking for love. But with Bombshells & Casa Amor, there's no time to relax. Hosted by Sophie Monk.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Love Island Australia is back in Mallorca, Spain for the hottest season yet. Join the Islanders for a summer of love with more dates, drama and romance than ever before. Hosted by Sophie Monk.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview:
Love Island is back in Mallorca, where our Islanders are hoping to find 'the one', they must

couple up and stay together to secure their place in the villa or risk being dumped.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview:
Welcome to Love Island Season 6! A luxurious place where our islanders will enjoy a

sizzling summer. They're smoking hot, desperately single, and ready to fall in love.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Love Island Australia returns in the most sinful season ever. Sophie Monk returns as host.
